excerpt.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
excerpt.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system
